== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1230_118</code>, Virtual Block 3 slip 120), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-120-Enhanced_Proton_Torpedoes.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB3-L-enhancedprotontorpedoes-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Enhanced Proton Torpedoes (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Use 1 Force to deploy on your starfighter. May target a starship for free. Draw destiny. If on a Heroic starfighter, may use 1 Force to add 3 to total. Target hit if destiny > defense value.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1230_118</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 3 set mark, slip number 120 as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Lore as printed on the Players Committee card image (“Rebellion technicians”). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB3-120-Enhanced_Proton_Torpedoes-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B07 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
